evals.name: windows-edit-full-page-preview
evals.prompt: Quiero agregar Steam y WhatsApp a la página de Stream de mi Ulanzi D200H y cambiar el color de la tecla de Discord a morado. Muéstrame cómo quedaría antes de aplicarlo.
evals.expected_output: Exports the active profile, notices the Stream page has no free keys, places Steam/WhatsApp without silently dropping existing keys (new page/folder or explicit proposal), recolors Discord purple, builds a preview PNG, and asks for approval before applying. Nothing in the real Ulanzi data folder changes.
assertions: Real Ulanzi data folder unchanged (profiles, settings and backups identical to the pre-run snapshot)
Edited layout includes Steam and WhatsApp keys
Steam and WhatsApp are on the Stream page itself, or the answer explains why they had to go into a folder/new page because the page is full
Discord key is visibly purple in the rendered key image (hue between ~250 and ~310 degrees)
No existing Stream-page key silently dropped (all original keys kept, or the answer names what it replaces)
A rendered preview of the Stream page (not just intermediate icons) is produced and shown or referenced in the answer
Answer asks for approval before applying (does not claim it was applied)
Answer tells the user what each changed key does

evals.name: macos-obs-discord-spotify
evals.prompt: Me compré un Ulanzi D200H y lo uso en mi MacBook Pro con Ulanzi Studio. Quiero una página con OBS, Discord, Spotify y botones para iniciar/parar la transmisión y la grabación de OBS. ¿Cómo lo configuro con este método? Dame los pasos y el archivo de layout listo para usar.
evals.expected_output: Step-by-step macOS guide that treats the data folder and hotkey/Open formats as unverified (discovery + calibration before apply), a portable layout JSON using app names and obs kinds, OBS WebSocket setup, uv/python3 commands, no Windows paths.
assertions: Treats the macOS data folder / formats as unverified and includes a discovery or calibration step
Layout has OBS, Discord and Spotify launchers plus OBS stream and record keys
layout.json passes `ulanzi.py build` validation (portable app names, no Windows paths)
Explains OBS WebSocket setup for the OBS keys
Tells the user to look at the preview (and the key list) before applying, and how to roll back

evals.name: linux-ubuntu-d200h
evals.prompt: Tengo Ubuntu 24.04 y un Ulanzi D200H. ¿Puedo usar Ulanzi Studio? Quiero teclas para abrir Firefox, la terminal y OBS, y un botón para silenciar el micrófono.
evals.expected_output: Says plainly Ulanzi Studio has no Linux version; recommends the unofficial community driver while flagging that D200H support is unconfirmed; gives concrete setup guidance for the four keys (or points to the driver's README) and offers rendering key art with build.
assertions: States plainly that Ulanzi Studio is not available for Linux
Recommends the OpenDeck + 'OpenDeck Ulanzi D200 Driver' plugin, which explicitly lists the D200H, as the primary option
Attributes any D200H support claim to its source and flags the tools as unofficial/community
Covers all four requested keys (Firefox, terminal, OBS, mic mute) with concrete actions
Mic mute works on Wayland (e.g. PipeWire wpctl/pactl), not only via simulated keyboard shortcuts
